svg.title: Trunk-Based Development
svg.desc: Trunk-Based Development. Everyone merges small changes into one main branch at least daily; feature flags hide unfinished work instead of long branches. Step 1, Three weeks on a branch: A 3-week branch touches 214 files: merging takes 2 days, and the bugs only show up in staging. Step 2, Merged the same day: Mai's 98-line PR: CI in 8 min, Ben's review, merged at 10:50, deployed at 11:00 with the flag off. Step 3, One day, nine merges: 9 merges from 6 developers in one day, each followed by a green build; a refactor lands in 3 steps. Step 4, Limits and pitfalls: It needs fast, reliable CI and quick reviews; old flags become debt; open source uses forks.
